3d.means: Actual three-dimensional transforms, not a fake.

3d effect.means: Reads three-dimensional without necessarily being real 3D.
3d effect.look_for: Faked shadows/skew that imply volume. Prefer '3d' when perspective is genuinely used.

alive.means: Idles rather than waiting - moves without being asked.
alive.look_for: A slow continuous float/drift, or pointer-tracking. animations.dev's 'float'.

artistic.look_for: Would sit comfortably in a gallery; composition matters more than conversion.

attention-grabbing.look_for: High contrast against its surroundings, motion where the eye is not already looking, or a loop.

bold.means: Loud and unmissable. Commits fully to the effect.
bold.look_for: Large travel or scale, heavy type, strong contrast, long confident duration (~900ms median here).

calm.means: Nothing competes for attention; the pace lowers your pulse.
calm.look_for: Single slow motion, no loops demanding attention, muted palette.

cascading.means: A staggered reveal that reads as a wave.
cascading.look_for: Stagger plus a directional order - left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

charming.look_for: Tiny idiosyncratic details; imperfection used deliberately.

circular.means: Motion follows an arc or a full rotation.
circular.look_for: `rotate()` as the main transform, or elements arranged on a radius.

classic.means: Familiar, timeless vocabulary. No trend markers.
classic.look_for: Fade, slide, simple scale. No 3D, no glitch, no neon. Would have looked fine ten years ago.

clean.means: Visually uncluttered - the motion reads instantly.
clean.look_for: Few colours (2-3), generous whitespace, one clear thing moving at a time.

cloudy.look_for: Blur filters, low-contrast washes, overlapping translucency.

confident.look_for: Single committed movement, snappy deceleration, no bounce-back. Figma's 'steep, snappy deceleration'.

continuous.means: Never fully stops while on screen.
continuous.look_for: `iterations: Infinity`, or a scroll-driven effect with no rest state.

cool.look_for: Restrained palette with one sharp accent; motion that does not try to please.

creative.means: An idea you have not seen applied this way.
creative.look_for: The mechanism itself is the novelty, not just the styling.

depth.means: Reads as having a front and a back.
depth.look_for: Overlap, scale-with-distance, blur-with-distance, or an explicit Z translation. 84% of presets tagged this are genuinely 3D.

dimensional.means: Occupies volume; you could walk around it.
dimensional.look_for: Multiple faces or planes visible at once.

dynamic.means: Visibly energetic; velocity is part of the message.
dynamic.look_for: Fast phases, direction changes, several elements moving at once at different rates.

edgy.look_for: Asymmetry, clipping, glitch, harsh timing, unexpected cuts.

effortless.means: Looks like it costs the interface nothing.
effortless.look_for: No strain, no bounce, no overshoot. Consistent velocity into a soft stop.

elegant.means: Restrained motion that still feels considered and expensive.
elegant.look_for: Asymmetric easing with a long deceleration, serif or high-contrast type, unhurried duration (600ms+).

endless.means: Reads as having no beginning or end.
endless.look_for: Seamless infinite loop - marquee, lane, wheel. You cannot identify frame zero.

energetic.look_for: Short durations (<400ms), overshoot in the easing curve, quick successive triggers.

experimental.means: Feels like a prototype exploring an idea.
experimental.look_for: Unusual mechanics, no established convention, may not survive a usability test.

expressive.means: The motion carries meaning beyond function.
expressive.look_for: The movement says something about the content - it is not a generic fade-in.

eye catching.look_for: Same meaning. Kept only because one existing row uses it.

eye-catching.means: Pulls the eye on first glance.
eye-catching.look_for: Same intent as attention-grabbing but usually via colour/shape rather than speed.

flowing.means: Continuous directional movement, like a current.
flowing.look_for: Sustained travel in one direction, overlapping element timing so there is never a still frame.

flowless.means: Ambiguous legacy term - probably meant 'flawless' or 'flowing'.
flowless.look_for: Do not apply to new rows; pick 'seamless' or 'flowing' instead.

fluid.look_for: Curved paths, easing without hard stops, shapes that bend rather than snap.

fun.look_for: Unexpected but harmless behaviour - wobble, squash, a face, a pop.

futuristic.look_for: 3D perspective, glass/neon, chromatic effects, unusual axis of movement.

gentle.means: Low amplitude. The motion is small relative to the element.
gentle.look_for: Travel under ~40px or scale change under ~10%. Nothing crosses the viewport.

graceful.means: Unhurried, curved, weight-bearing motion - it looks like it has mass.
graceful.look_for: Arcs rather than straight lines, no sudden direction changes, slow settle. NN/g's 'long gradual deceleration'.

gradual.means: The change is spread across a long span; no single moment carries it.
gradual.look_for: Scroll-linked with `linear` easing over a tall section (300vh+). Scrubbing back and forth feels identical.

graphic.means: Poster-like. Reads as flat shape and type.
graphic.look_for: Oversized type, hard-edged shapes, strong figure/ground, often masks rather than 3D.

groovy.means: Rhythmic, slightly retro, on a beat.
groovy.look_for: Repeating cycles with a swing feel; wavy rather than linear paths.

high-end.look_for: Slow, generous timing, dark or monochrome palette, serif display type, lots of negative space.

horizontal.look_for: translateX dominates; row layouts; sideways travel.

horizontal movement.means: Legacy phrasing for sideways travel - prefer 'horizontal'.
horizontal movement.look_for: Same cue as 'horizontal'. Kept only because existing rows use it.

horizontal scroll.means: Vertical scrolling is remapped to sideways travel.
horizontal scroll.look_for: A sticky viewport with a wide track moved by translateX.

immersive.means: Fills your field of view; you are inside it.
immersive.look_for: Full-viewport, edge-to-edge, no visible page chrome.

impactful.means: Lands with force - there is a moment of arrival.
impactful.look_for: A sharp deceleration into the final state, often with scale. You feel it stop.

innovative.means: New technique, not just new styling.
innovative.look_for: Uses a capability most sites do not - scroll-linked 3D, pointer-driven fields, masked type.

inspirational.means: Aspirational tone; makes you want the thing.
inspirational.look_for: Wide landscape imagery, generous scale, uplifting upward movement.

interactive.means: Responds to you, not to the scroll position.
interactive.look_for: Requires a hover / click / pointermove / interest trigger. THIS IS A HARD RULE: scroll-only work is never 'interactive'.

layered.look_for: 3+ visually separated depth planes with different motion rates.

minimal.means: Reduced to the fewest possible moving parts.
minimal.look_for: One or two properties animating; sparse composition; often just opacity + a small transform.

modern.look_for: Large geometric sans, flat or subtle-gradient surfaces, generous radii, scroll-linked motion.

organic.look_for: Blob shapes, uneven timing, nothing perfectly aligned to a grid.

organized.means: Everything lands on a grid or rhythm.
organized.look_for: Consistent spacing and equal timing steps; alignment is obvious.

perspective.look_for: A `perspective()` value; parallel edges converge; near elements move faster.

playful.means: Invites you to mess with it.
playful.look_for: Overshoot/bounce in the curve, exaggeration, response to hover or pointer.

polished.means: Finished. Every state and edge is handled.
polished.look_for: Hover, active and rest states all defined; nothing pops or reflows; timing consistent across siblings.

poppy.look_for: Very short duration with visible overshoot - a spring with low damping (bounce).

refined.means: Nothing extraneous. Every moving part is doing work.
refined.look_for: Few simultaneous properties, consistent timing between siblings, no decorative wobble.

revealing.means: Content is uncovered rather than moved.
revealing.look_for: Masks, clip-path, wipes, curtains. The element does not travel - the window onto it changes.

seamless.means: No visible seam, join or restart point.
seamless.look_for: Loops where you cannot spot the wrap; transitions where the outgoing and incoming states share geometry.

silky.look_for: Transform/opacity only (GPU-friendly), no layout thrash, no jitter under fast scroll.

simple.means: A single readable idea, easy to describe in one sentence.
simple.look_for: If explaining it needs an 'and then', it is not simple.

smooth.means: No visible jerk, stutter or hard stop anywhere in the motion.
smooth.look_for: One continuous curve per property. Ease-out or a gentle cubic-bezier, nothing linear-and-abrupt. If it stutters on scroll it is not smooth.

soft.means: No hard edges in either the easing or the visuals.
soft.look_for: Long tails on the easing, blur, feathered masks, rounded corners, low-contrast palette.

sophisticated.means: Complex underneath, simple on the surface.
sophisticated.look_for: Several coordinated properties that resolve into one apparent movement. Orchestration, not a single tween.

spatial.means: The layout itself is a space you move through.
spatial.look_for: Movement implies travel - into a room, along a corridor, through layers.

spiraling.means: Rotation combined with scale or depth - a helix.
spiraling.look_for: rotate + scale together, or rotate + translateZ.

staggered.means: Siblings start one after another, not together.
staggered.look_for: A per-item delay of roughly 40-100ms. animations.dev: prevents the 'lacks elegance' parallel entrance.

structured.look_for: Repeating modules, clear hierarchy, motion that respects the layout.

subtle.means: You notice the result, not the movement.
subtle.look_for: Would a non-designer even register it happened? If the effect announces itself, it is not subtle.

surprising.means: Does something you did not predict.
surprising.look_for: The second half of the motion contradicts what the first half implied.

techy.look_for: Monospace type, grid overlays, stepped/`steps()` timing, scan-lines, dark UI.

transformative.look_for: Start and end states are different in kind, not just position - shape morphs, folds, squeezes.

unconventional.look_for: Scroll that moves sideways, nav that is not at the top, reversed reading order.

understated.means: Deliberately less than it could have been.
understated.look_for: The effect is clearly held back - short travel, low opacity change, no flourish at the end.

unique.look_for: One distinctive gesture that no other preset here repeats.

vertical.look_for: translateY dominates; column layouts; top-to-bottom reveals.

z axis.means: Legacy phrasing for depth movement - prefer 'depth' or '3d'.

zoom.look_for: `scale()` doing most of the work - push in or pull out.
